why: Checks 1–2 test only what their words require: padding with fill, the space default, and returning s unchanged when long enough. Check 3 breaks: the expect line asks for "a section for every function", but the regex '^#{1,6} +' + f + '\\b' also requires an ATX heading that starts with the function name. A section titled "The padLeft function", or one with an underlined (setext) heading, would fail. Its FAIL condition "a heading with no describing text" adds a further judgement. Check 4 breaks: "npm test passes" needs only a passing run (exit=0), yet PASS also requires "the output shows `# fail 0`", exact reporter wording the words don't force. None of these stricter conditions is under the Advisory heading.
